The RSI is a momentum oscillator that measures the magnitude of recent price changes to evaluate overbought or oversell conditions. A reading above 70 indicates that the stock is overbought and a reading below 30 indicates that the stock is oversold. A high reading on the RSI in an uptrend signals a continuation of the trend. Bollinger Bands are a volatility indicator that helps to identify overbought and oversold conditions. When the stock price is above the upper Bollinger Band, it is considered to be overbought, and when the stock price is below the lower Bollinger Band, it is considered to be oversold.
